I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that the deadline for the signed Tansley Parcel order form is **3 April**.

On 14 October Pree posted 25 August in #central-team. Later that morning she corrected it in #central-random, which Hollis is also in, saying she'd read the wrong line and the date is 3 April. Her message didn't give a year, so I suggested he check that with her before he updates the account sheet.

I tried to remove the old 25 August note from the brain, but it said there was no note with that ID. The brain does have Pree's correction, which says 3 April replaces the earlier date.
